t: The Bosch multi-material drill and screwdriver bit set includes 103 pieces for comprehensive drilling and screwdriving tasks in various materials. This robust and compact kit provides essential accessories for trade professionals, ideal for plumbing, electrical installations, and general building work. It includes a wide selection of metal, wood, and masonry drill bits, along with numerous screwdriver bits, holesaws, and nut setters, all neatly organised in a durable ABS plastic blow-moulded case. Designed for use with 3-jaw chuck machines in both rotary and impact modes.
b: Contents: 19 Metal Drill Bits, 53 Screwdriver Bits, 2 Spade Bits, 5 Masonry Drill Bits, Bit Holder, 4 Holesaws, Hole Saw Adapter, 9 Wood Drill Bits, 7 Nut Setters, Countersink & Allen Key.
Suitable For Use with 3-Jaw Chuck Machines on Rotary & Impact Modes
Suitable for Wood, Plastic, Concrete, Brick, Light Building Materials, Multi-Layer Materials & Masonry
Features Holesaws & Nut Setters For Versatility
Organised Kit for Easy Bit Identification & Storage
Supplied With Robust ABS Plastic Carry Case
